name: The Big Picture

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you help keep Northshire Valley peaceful and recover stolen goods from the encroaching vermin.
As a human adventurer, you begin your service at Northshire Abbey, protecting Stormwind's outlying territories.

faq.answer: Shinyfinder Narf leads kobolds deep in the mine near Northshire Valley. He hoards stolen books and calls for picture books, so local authorities have ordered his cache recovered.

aliases: why do kobolds want picture books
faq.answer: Kobolds from the mine have been seen shouting, “Picture for Narf!” as they snatch books. Narf seeks illustrated works and keeps them in a sack deep in the tunnels.
faq.q: Why are the kobolds stealing books?

faq.answer: The stolen books belong to Brother Paxton, who lives at Northshire Abbey. Marshal McBride receives the recovered sack and arranges for the books to return to Brother Paxton's collection.
Marshal McBride is the law enforcement officer stationed just inside Northshire Abbey. He keeps order, protects the abbey grounds and organizes defense against the local kobolds.
Shinyfinder Narf lives in the deeper, more dangerous reaches of the mine in Northshire Valley. Meaner kobolds surround him and guard his hoard.
faq.q: Where can Shinyfinder Narf be found?

faq.answer: The kobolds deeper in the mine with Narf are meaner and more hostile than the common scavengers outside. Narf and his den are dangerous for anyone traveling alone.
faq.q: How dangerous is the mine where Narf lives?

sections.body: Kobolds in Northshire Valley have been seen fleeing with books and crying, “Picture for Narf!” Most gather candles and shiny trinkets, but Shinyfinder Narf seeks illustrated tomes. He has collected a sack of them in his hideout beneath the mine.
sections.title: The Kobold Book Thief

sections.body: The deeper shafts hold tougher, meaner kobolds who guard Narf and his strange hoard. To recover the stolen books, you face those darker tunnels and confront him. Then the sack goes to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey, who sees that the valuable volumes return to Brother Paxton.
sections.title: Recovering the Abbey's Tomes

summary: In Northshire Valley, kobolds carry stolen illustrated books into the mine for Shinyfinder Narf. The volumes are to be returned to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey.
